title: the Effect of Different Modialites of Varicocelectomy on Semen Parameters in Patient With Normal Semen Analysis
brief_summary: to evalute the effect inguinal and subinguinal approach of varicoceclectomy on semen parameter for patients complaining of varicocele with normal semen parameter (pain is the main complaint)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age more than 19 years old
* primary varicocele

Exclusion Criteria:

* secondary varicocele recurrent varicocele age less than 19 years
study_population: Male patients undergoing varicocelectomy while having normal semen parameters (doing surgery for other reasons eg. pain)
